newsitem.title: USA: NYSE considers delisting Mercury Finance Co.
newsitem.headline: NYSE considers delisting Mercury Finance Co.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday it was initiating a review of Mercury Finance Co's eligibility for continued listing on the exchange.

The exchange said it based its action on information from the company stating that its auditor's formal opinion is expected to raise doubts about the company's ability to continue as a going concern, primarily because Mercury continues to be in default of its debt agreement.
Mercury said that its audit opinion will be available by the end of May.
